svg.text: Aggregate scores in memory, make one batched DB call, then commit the Kafka offset. Stored message_offset makes replays idempotent

svg.text: Function maintains each product type's top-N sorted set in Redis

svg.text: Search resolves the query (e.g. 'gifts for a 10 year old' → toy, comic book) via a context ML service, reads the sorted sets and merges in memory

svg.text: Cache miss falls back to the DynamoDB index (product type, sorted by score)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Scale: 10M DAU × 10 searches ≈ 1k QPS (100k peak); 10 clicks/user → 100k/s peak; 100k advertisers × 10 ads/day → 10/s (1k peak)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Storage: 100k × 10 × 500 B × 365 × 3 replicas × 10 yrs ≈ 5.5 TB: no need to shard for size, but 100k writes/s peak means shard for throughput

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • IO-bound, not compute-bound; 4 nines target, eventual consistency; durability: no lost clicks or ads
